description: This file defines a NestJS guard class 'PbacGuard' that manages permission-based access control (PBAC) for API endpoints, including caching permission checks with Redis and feature flag checks.

classes.name: PbacGuard
classes.description: A NestJS guard implementing permission checks with caching for access control.

methods.name: canActivate
methods.description: Main method to determine if a request is authorized based on PBAC.

methods.name: hasPbacEnabled
methods.description: Checks if PBAC is enabled for a team, with caching.

methods.name: checkUserHasRequiredPermissions
methods.description: Verifies if a user has the required permissions, with caching.

methods.name: getCacheRequiredPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves cached permission check result from Redis.

methods.name: setCacheRequiredPermissions
methods.description: Stores permission check result in Redis cache.

methods.name: getCachePbacEnabled
methods.description: Retrieves cached PBAC enabled status from Redis.

methods.name: setCachePbacEnabled
methods.description: Stores PBAC enabled status in Redis cache.

methods.name: throwForbiddenError
methods.description: Throws a ForbiddenException with a detailed message if permissions are insufficient.
